subject.title: Add bounded PR detail fill command

question: Should Gitcrawl accept `fill-pr-details` as a top-level syncer-backed command with these first-version flags, defaults, progress output, and reserve-rate-limit behavior after rebase?
rationale: The implementation is focused and proven, but it creates a new user-facing CLI contract for bounded archive hydration, and the linked issue is already marked as needing product direction.

options.title: Accept after rebase and tests
options.body: Resolve the current main conflict, run focused CLI/store validation, and merge this as the first supported bounded PR-detail fill surface.

options.title: Revise the command contract first
options.body: Ask for specific flag/default/quota behavior changes before merge if maintainers want a narrower or different first version.

options.title: Defer bounded fill
options.body: Pause or close this PR if bounded fill should wait for a broader archive workflow or different interface.

recommendation.title: Accept after rebase and tests
recommendation.body: Resolve the current main conflict, run focused CLI/store validation, and merge this as the first supported bounded PR-detail fill surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter owns the strongest git-history signal for the PR-detail hydration and sync paths that define the command's product boundary.
